title: Agentic-SOLID-QE Session Tape
description: Strict contract bridging Skill 01 (CLI Explorer) and Skill 02 (SOLID Architect). Translates ephemeral @playwright/cli YAML refs into hierarchical, strict-mode-safe Playwright semantic locators.

scenarioId.description: Kebab-case unique identifier matching the tape filename.

apiBaseUrl.description: Optional separate-origin API base URL when backend endpoints live on a different domain than baseUrl.

dataBuilderRef.description: Reference to a typed Data Builder method in src/data/ (e.g. UserBuilder.standardUser).

storageStatePath.description: Optional reusable Playwright storageState path (e.g., .auth/standard.json) generated by 00-env-bootstrap.

actors.description: Optional multi-portal/multi-persona actors for cross-portal E2E handoffs (e.g., Customer B2C Quote Portal -> Back-Office Underwriter Agent Portal).

capturedVariables.description: Optional cross-page or cross-portal runtime values captured during earlier UI or API steps (e.g. generated Quote ID, Policy Number, Referral ID, dynamic premium) to assert or use on subsequent steps.

jsonPath.description: Optional dot-path when source is apiResponseJson (e.g., data.quoteId or policy.policyNumber).

actor.description: Optional actorId (referencing root actors) executing this step in a cross-portal flow (e.g., customer vs. agent_underwriter).

portalUrl.description: Optional portal base URL override when a cross-portal step switches to a secondary application (e.g. Back-Office Agent Portal).

pageRoute.description: Optional route path where this step executes in a multi-page flow (e.g. /checkout-step-one.html).

conditionRef.description: Optional RiskProfile/Data Builder boolean reference controlling conditional wizard branching (e.g. MotorRiskBuilder.withPriorClaim().hasClaims).

cliRefSource.description: Original ephemeral ref from .playwright-cli/page-*.yml (e.g., e14) for audit traceability.

key.description: Key name for 'press' actions (e.g., Enter, Tab, Escape).

inputDataRef.description: Symbolic reference to src/data/ builder field (never raw magic strings in specs).

waitForUrl.description: Optional URL path or glob to synchronize multi-page navigation after this step.

waitForNetwork.description: Optional API URL pattern from networkContracts to await after triggering this action.

capturesVariable.description: Optional variable name (matching capturedVariables) extracted from this element or API response for cross-page/cross-portal verification.

componentCandidate.description: Suggested SRP Component, Page, or API Client class name (e.g., VehicleLookupComponent, MotorQuoteApiClient).

locatorContract.description: Hierarchical Locator Contract ensuring strict-mode safety on complex pages (or endpoint descriptor when action is apiCall).

iframeSelector.description: Optional iframe selector when the target control lives inside an embedded frame (e.g., PCI Payment iframe).

parentScope.description: Optional parent landmark/container scoping (e.g., dialog, form, region, listitem, table row) to prevent strict-mode collisions.

filterTextRef.description: Optional Data Builder reference or text filter (.filter({ hasText })) to disambiguate repeating rows/cards.

role.description: ARIA role when strategy is getByRole (e.g., button, textbox, heading, link).

value.description: Accessible name, label, placeholder, text, testId value, or API endpoint path.

maxLatencyMs.description: Optional SLA latency threshold observed during exploration.

clientCandidate.description: Optional typed Playwright APIRequestContext client class to generate/reuse (e.g. QuoteRatingApiClient).

requestBuilderRef.description: Optional Data Builder method producing the typed request payload.

responseSchemaSummary.description: Optional concise summary of key response JSON fields (e.g. '{ quoteId: string, annualPremium: number, referralRequired: boolean }').

actor.description: Optional actorId whose portal/context this assertion evaluates against.

targetComponent.description: Fixture/Component/ApiClient exposing the readonly Locator or response state.

targetProperty.description: Readonly Locator property or query method on the Component/Page/ApiClient.

expectedValueRef.description: Symbolic reference to src/data/ builder, expected constant, or capturedVariable:<name>.
